name: pam_canonicalize_user
description: Canonicalize username to its standard form
detailed_description: Authentication module that obtains the user name and canonicalizes it according to the system's user database. Ensures that the PAM_USER item contains the official login name from the system database. Useful for handling user name aliases and case sensitivity issues.
notes:
Modern module (2023+) that canonicalizes user names. Maps user aliases to standard login names from /etc/passwd.
